title: Stone Game II
goal: Find how many stones the first player can guarantee in Stone Game II.
strategy: The state is the current pile index and limit M. Taking X piles leaves the opponent an optimal suffix state with max(M,X); subtract that opponent result from the suffix total and maximize over legal X.
